repo_notes.content: This is the OpenSprinkler Unified Firmware for ESP32, ESP8266, and Linux/OSPi (Raspberry Pi) platforms. It is a C/C++ embedded irrigation controller firmware with a flat source tree — all core .cpp/.h files live in the repository root. Key subsystems include: (1) Core architecture: main.cpp (main loop & state machine), OpenSprinkler.cpp/.h (HAL, IO expanders, station control), program.cpp/.h (scheduling engine, ProgramData, RuntimeQueueStruct), defines.h (global constants, PSRAM macros, config filenames). (2) Networking: opensprinkler_server.cpp (HTTP REST API with ~40 endpoints), espconnect.cpp (WiFi/Ethernet/captive portal), mqtt.cpp (MQTT pub/sub via PubSubClient/mosquitto), mcp_server.cpp (Model Context Protocol for AI agents), opensprinkler_matter.cpp (Matter smart home), opensprinkler_rainmaker.cpp (ESP RainMaker / Alexa / Google Home — 2500+ lines, major subsystem). (3) Sensors: sensors.cpp/.h (framework, SensorBase polymorphic hierarchy, monitors, program adjustments, logging), sensor_ble.cpp (BLE), sensor_zigbee*.cpp (Zigbee gateway/client), sensor_mqtt.cpp, sensor_asb.cpp (analog), sensor_modbus_rtu.cpp (RS485), sensor_fyta.cpp, sensor_remote.cpp, sensor_weather.cpp, sensor_group.cpp (MIN/MAX/AVG/SUM aggregation), sensor_ospi_ble.cpp (Linux BLE via BlueZ). (4) Build system: platformio.ini (ESP32/ESP8266 targets with Matter/Zigbee variants), build.sh/build2.sh/Makefile (Linux/OSPi), fw.sh (firmware release manager), pre_build_sdkconfig.py/fix_build.py (ESP-IDF patches). (5) Memory management: psram_utils.cpp (PSRAM initialization, task allocation), esp32c5_spiram_optimization.ld (linker scripts), mbedtls_spiram_alloc.c. (6) Utilities: weather.cpp (weather service client), notifier.cpp (IFTTT/email/MQTT alerts), osinfluxdb.cpp (InfluxDB telemetry), online_update.cpp (OTA with SHA-256 verification), acme_client.cpp (Let's Encrypt), TimeLib.cpp, utils.cpp, SSD1306Display.h/LiquidCrystal.cpp (display drivers). Documentation should cover all these subsystems with emphasis on the ESP RainMaker integration (opensprinkler_rainmaker.cpp) which is currently the largest undocumented module.
